info.title: Follow-up CRM API
info.description:
REST API for the Lead Generation & Follow-up Android app.

**Auth:** call `POST /api/auth/login` (demo: `admin@example.com` / `password`), copy the `token`, click **Authorize** and paste it.

**Dates:** send `YYYY-MM-DD` dates and `HH:MM` (24h) times; responses include ISO-8601 timestamps plus separate date/time fields.

**Follow-ups:** a lead has at most one *pending* follow-up (its next follow-up). Completed follow-ups form the lead's timeline.

post.summary: Create an account and get a token
Log in and get a bearer token

get.summary: Dashboard counters, today’s follow-ups and recent leads
Follow-up lists: today, upcoming, overdue, pending, completed

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: today = pending scheduled today (past ones flagged is_overdue); upcoming = after today; overdue = pending past due

get.summary: Pending follow-ups in a time window — for scheduling local notifications
get.description: The app can call this after login/sync and schedule an Android local notification for each item. Defaults to the next 7 days.

get.summary: Daily reminder text for pending follow-ups

message.example: You have 4 follow-ups due today and 2 overdue.

delete.summary: Delete a note or cancel a pending follow-up

post.summary: Mark a follow-up completed and schedule the next one automatically
post.description:
Records the call outcome. Unless `schedule_next=false` or an explicit next date is sent, the next follow-up is auto-scheduled:

| Status after call | Next follow-up |
|---|---|
| Not Answered / Callback | +1 day |
| Interested | +1 day (High), +3 (Medium), +5 (Low) |
| Closed | none |

The original time of day is kept and Sundays are skipped.

put.summary: Edit a lead (send only the fields to change)

delete.summary: Delete a lead and its follow-ups

200.description: Pending follow-up first, then notes newest first

post.summary: Add a follow-up note (date, time, note, status after call)

get.summary: Download all leads as Excel or CSV

post.summary: Import leads from Excel (.xlsx) or CSV
post.description:
First row must be a header. Required column: **Customer Name**. Optional: ID, Mobile Number, Email, Company Name, Lead Source, Status, Priority, Notes, Next Follow-up Date, Next Follow-up Time.

Rows matching an existing lead by ID or mobile number update it; others are created. Use the export file as a template.

next_followup_date.description: Send null to clear the schedule

note.example: Asked for revised pricing, call back Friday

schedule_next.description: true = auto-schedule next follow-up from call status + priority; false = no next follow-up; omitted = keep the current schedule (notes) / auto-schedule (complete)

Followup.description: Pending rows are scheduled reminders; completed rows are timeline notes.

date.description: Date of the note (completed) or due date (pending)

is_overdue.description: Pending and past its time — show in red

current_page.description: Laravel paginator `meta` block returned by list endpoints.
